# PR #43 — skip-audit marker

PR #43 (`docs(readme): add 3 terminal screenshots + dashboard for visual impact`)
touches 4 files:

- `README.md`                    — docs, auto-skipped by audit.yml docs-only regex
- `assets/terminal-write.png`    — protected format (`**/*.png`), no audit record
- `assets/terminal-status.png`   — protected format (`**/*.png`), no audit record
- `assets/terminal-log.png`      — protected format (`**/*.png`), no audit record

The audit.yml docs-only auto-skip whitelist covers `README*.md` and `docs/**`
but not `assets/**`. Without this marker, `pandaone ci` would FAIL because
the new PNG files have no APPROVED audit record (and rightly so — they're
generated by the render script in `scripts/`, not hand-edited).

This PR is purely documentation / visual impact; no source code is touched.
The L1-L7 defense layers are unaffected by PNG additions.

## Why each PNG is safe to skip-audit

1. `assets/terminal-write.png` — rendered by `scripts/render_readme_screens.py`
   using real audit data from a sandboxed `pandaone write` (no production data).
2. `assets/terminal-status.png` — same script, sandboxed data.
3. `assets/terminal-log.png` — same script, sandboxed data.
4. `assets/dashboard.png` — pre-existing asset from v0.7.x, re-used.

## Reproduction

```bash
python scripts/render_readme_screens.py
# produces 3 PNGs in assets/, total ~78 KB
```
